subject: Error message: Constraint applied to fixed parameter(s)

messages.author: 4a5c80989676d9e2
messages.subject: Error message: Constraint applied to fixed parameter(s)
parts:
Hello again and thank you for being so helpful!

I'm running a DIF analysis and getting this error message: "Constraint applied to fixed parameter(s) 302 636 970  but should only be applied to estimated parameters. Please fix!"

The code that I'm running is:

itemnames <- colnames(data)
anc.items.names <- itemnames[c(5,20)] # anchored items without DIF
test.items <- c(1:4,6:19,21:25) # items with suspected DIF
model_anchor <- multipleGroup(data, model = 3, group = group,
                              invariance = c(anc.items.names, 'free_means', 'free_var'),
                              itemtype = "nominal",
                              TOL = .005)

dif.anchor <- DIF(model_anchor, c('a1','a2','a3','ak1','ak2','ak3','d1','d2','d3','d4'),
                  items2test = test.items, plotdif = TRUE, TOL = .005) # error happens here


I would be very grateful for any guidance on how to solve my problem. 

Thanks!
Tom

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Error message: Constraint applied to fixed parameter(s)
parts:
What does 

mod2values(model_anchor)[c( 302, 636, 970), ] 

return? This should give some insight as to what is going on.
  
Phil

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Error message: Constraint applied to fixed parameter(s)
parts:
Notice that all the $est elements here are FALSE? This means that these parameters were not estimated in the model, and therefore applying equality constraints to them is not meaningful. It might be best to omit this item from the DIF search via the items2test argument just so that it doesn't cause issues. 

Phil
